shortDefinition: AI technology that converts spoken audio into written text.
fullDefinition: Speech-to-Text (STT) technology converts audio of human speech into text. Modern AI-based STT systems achieve very high accuracy even in noisy environments and with diverse accents. OpenAI's Whisper is a widely used open STT model. STT powers voice assistants, transcription services, meeting notes tools (Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai), and voice interfaces for AI chatbots.
